posts.raw_content:
I know, cue the NPC line

> tHiS is NoT aN AiRpoRt

I have spent decades heavily involved in politics. It has ruined my life in so many ways: career, relationships, mental health, basically everything.

I just wanted to be a good person and help good people. But after seeing Charlie Kirk murdered and Democrats win a landslide election, I think I’m kidding myself. I’m not accomplishing much. Charlie Kirk dedicated his entire life to politics and they just shot him and extinguished his impact forever. I’m not even half the man he was. 

Another thing that really brought me to this point was seeing a mod here calling for all “MIGA” people to be cut out of the movement. Translation: vote for Massie and DeSantis. This is such a disingenuous and faggoty thing to say, like everyone here who agreed with Trump’s decision to not let Iranian terrorists get a nuclear bomb just loves da Jews. 

I’m sick of wasting my time arguing with teenagers about topics they know nothing about. Now that I know a mod here is on their side it makes a lot of sense as to how this site got to its current state. I think FBI is a great guy but he can only do so much when there’s such cunts here protecting the Fuentes Faggots. This is the best political site on the entire internet but it’s still not worth it to me anymore. Sadly, after fighting maniacally to keep this site pro-Trump for 6+ years, I am surrendering to the shills. 

With all that being said, I apologize to the genuine patriots who are anti-Israel and not shills. I insulted you way too hard. I have major anger issues and can’t help it, and being on this site and in politics in general just fuels the fire. I’m addicted to being angry.

Farewell to all of you patriots. I am sorry for deserting this war. All I can say in my defense is I’ve done more than 99% of people ever will. I am working towards something great at the moment that people here would really respect but I am not going to reveal private info.

I am taking the blue pill. I’m going back to watching sports and looking for a stupid woman who just wants to go camping and eat marshmallows. I understand how pathetic this is as much as anyone. I hate the person I am advocating becoming and I hope none of you follow my path.

But at this point I am so broken by politics that I have no other choice if I ever want to get my life back together, like it was before everything went to hell in 2016. Trump is a god-tier leader, but fighting with him this whole time genuinely broke me.

To be clear, I don’t think we are all doomed and I don’t even think the midterm loss was that big of a deal. It was a historical norm. This is more about the impact politics has had on me personally than a belief that everything is hopeless. It is not. Trump gave us a chance to save our country. 

Last thing I will say is MAGA should support Vance, never DeSantis. DeSantis is the biggest fraud I’ve ever seen in politics. He pretends to be more based than Trump, repeating shit he doesn’t believe, repeating anything he can to drive a wedge as he criticizes Trump from the bleachers, but he really is nothing more than a Bush puppet. I’m not wasting another 4 years here trying to convince people of this though. I’m done. 

God bless you all. Even the haters and losers.
